# Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection port tracking

Generated from Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection commit `6aa72daa24f66c01c3d7b6a32519e9d21396deec` (reference `dependency-injection` of `scripts/port-status/references.toml`). The plan of this port: [dependency-injection.md](../../dependency-injection.md); the tracking of the framework itself: [TRACKING.md](../../TRACKING.md).

Counted: the public API, public and protected types and members (with explicit interface implementations). Internal types (upstream's operator classes and their sinks, the internal helpers) are implementation; they count only through their files, which are ported one to one. Overloads are found by name: every overload of a method counts as present once the Rust function of its name in snake case exists, or that name with a suffix (`_on` for a scheduler argument, `_with`, `_with_index`, ...) or the `try_` prefix. The methods a `*_methods!` macro writes into a trait or an `impl` count as methods of that trait or type. An upstream file without a Rust file at its own path is present in the Rust files whose module documentation (the leading `//!` lines) cites it, such as `Linq/Observable/Select.cs`. A missing file whose types are all waived counts as a waived file.

## How to regenerate

```sh
scripts/port-status/run.sh --reference dependency-injection            # the checkout at ../runtime, or $DI_UPSTREAM
scripts/port-status/run.sh --reference dependency-injection --check    # exit 1 when a document is out of date; writes nothing
python3 scripts/port-status/test_gaps.py --reference dependency-injection --all   # the test reports, before run.sh
python3 scripts/port-status/port_status.py --reference dependency-injection --explain <Project> <File.cs>
```

Inputs: the project list `scripts/api-extract/projects-dependency-injection.json`, the extraction `docs/porting/data/dependency-injection/upstream-api.json`, `docs/porting/data/dependency-injection/path-overrides.toml`, `docs/porting/data/dependency-injection/member-waivers.toml` and `docs/porting/data/dependency-injection/test-aliases.toml`. Outputs: this directory (`docs/porting/tracking/dependency-injection/`) and `docs/porting/data/dependency-injection/port-status.json`.
